label: July 27 – August 2, 2026
intro: Double public holiday mid-week — Asalha Bucha (Wed) and Khao Phansa (Thu) mean a golden chance for temple magic and a workshop day, plus a chill family weekend.

activities.title: Asalha Bucha Evening Candle Ceremony
activities.location: Wat Pho or Wat Arun, riverside
activities.price: Temple entry fees (~100 THB Wat Arun)
activities.why: Thousands of candles, monks in procession, golden spires glowing over the river — a Bucha ceremony is genuinely magical for a 5-year-old. Cross the Chao Phraya by long-tail for bonus adventure points.
activities.tip: Morning is cooler; evening ceremony (after 6pm) is more spectacular. Go early to avoid the crush if Thor gets overwhelmed by crowds.

activities.title: Holiday Workshop at Toob North — theCOMMONS
activities.price: Free to browse; sessions priced per session
activities.why: Two mid-week holidays = prime workshop time without using a vacation day. The northern makers' market is still running — potters, craftspeople, and food from Chiang Mai all week.
activities.tip: Popular during holidays — arrive at opening.

activities.title: Roller Dome Weekend Session
activities.why: Great Saturday plan after the midweek holidays — get Thor back on wheels in SE Asia's biggest indoor roller rink. Coaches on standby for beginners.
activities.tip: Arrive at 11am to beat the post-holiday weekend crowd.

activities.title: The Marvel Experience Thailand
activities.why: Iron Man's Stark Mobile Lab, Flight Training, 4D dome, and character meet-and-greets. The holiday weekend is a great excuse to finally make the trip if you haven't yet.
activities.tip: Book tickets on Klook in advance — holiday weekends sell out. BTS to On Nut then Grab (~30 min).

activities.title: Kad Kokoa Kids Chocolate Workshop
activities.why: Monthly kids bonbon sessions in small groups. Holiday week is a good moment to book the next one before August slots fill up.
activities.tip: Follow Kad Kokoa on LINE Official to get notified of new dates.
